## Checklist

- [ ] One customization per pull request, in `Kits/<Name>`, named after its object's class
- [ ] `python Build.py Kits/<Name>` passes
- [ ] I uploaded the `.manimkit` to my own Customizations in Manimator and it draws and plays as intended
- [ ] `kit.js` and `kit.py` draw the same thing
- [ ] `author` is my GitHub user name and `license` is `MIT`
- [ ] It's my own work, or copied only from code whose license allows MIT
- [ ] A change to an existing one has a new `version`
